ownerOnly: Only platform owners can configure where operations work lands.

contacts.title: Who to contact
contacts.description: The address a notice gives when it tells somebody to get in touch — for example, somebody whose account or community is suspended. A kind of work left blank uses the general contact; with neither set, the notice says to contact whoever runs this server.

guild.title: Operations community
guild.description: The community that receives this deployment's security, moderation, support and feedback work.
guild.label: Community
guild.helpText: An ordinary community in every respect. Its superadmin chooses which project each stream lands in, from the community's own settings.
guild.setUpInCommunity: {{name}}'s superadmin sets which project each stream lands in, under Community settings › Intake.
guild.saveError: Could not save the operations community.
guild.clearBody: Every stream stops receiving. The projects and everything in them stay exactly as they are, and choosing this community again restores what was set up.

community.title: Where operations work lands
community.description: This community receives this deployment's security, moderation, support and feedback work. Choose the project each kind lands in.
community.seatOnly: Only this community's superadmin can set up where operations work lands.
community.notOperations: This community doesn't receive this deployment's operations work, so it has no intake to set up.

security.title: Security
security.description: Cases raised by rules watching this deployment.

support.title: Support
support.description: Help requests from people using this deployment.

feedback.title: Feedback
feedback.description: What people have told us they want.

stream.setUpHelp: Set this up and you get a ready-made project with its own statuses and fields, which you can restructure however you like afterwards. Or point the stream at a project you already have.
stream.existingProjectLabel: Or use a project you already have
stream.repointNote: Pointing a stream at a different project starts fresh there. Anything still open stays in the project the work on it is in.
stream.unbindBody: The project and every case in it stay. Pointing the stream back at the same project picks up where it left off.
stream.unboundToast: That stream is no longer routed.
stream.archivedNote: This project has been archived, so nothing can land in it. Bring it back, or point this stream at a live project.

loadFailed.title: Could not load these settings
loadFailed.description: Nothing has been changed. Try again, and if it keeps failing the server log will say why.

help.title: Ask for help
help.description: Tell us what is going on and somebody will pick it up.
help.subjectPlaceholder: One line, so it can be found again
help.bodyPlaceholder: What you were doing, what you expected, and what happened instead.
help.thanks: Sent. Somebody will pick it up.
help.error: Could not send that. Try again in a moment.
